name: api-auth-reverse-proxy
description: A stateless proxy to allow short-lived credentials against APIs requiring long-lived credentials

scripts.deploy:cdk: npm run build && cdk deploy --app 'npx tsx infrastructure/cdk/app.ts'
scripts.deploy:terraform: npm run build && terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform init && terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform apply
scripts.test:terraform: terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform init -backend=false && terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform validate && terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform test
